channels.name: CK / CK#
channels.purpose: Differential clock (single-ended CK at 1.8 V); double data rate.
channels.idle_level: may be stopped when CS# high

channels.name: CS#
channels.purpose: Chip select, active low, one per device.

channels.name: RWDS
channels.purpose: Variable-latency indicator (CA) / read data strobe / write byte mask.
channels.active_levels: memory-driven (CA indicator, read strobe) or host-driven (write mask)

global_signals.name: CK / CK#
global_signals.purpose: Shared differential clock for the bus.

handshake_pairs.name: CS#-transaction
handshake_pairs.rule: CS# low frames the whole transaction; CS# high ends it.

handshake_pairs.name: RWDS-variable-latency
handshake_pairs.rule: RWDS driven during CA tells the host 1x vs 2x latency.

handshake_pairs.name: RWDS-read-strobe
handshake_pairs.rule: RWDS strobes DDR read data for source-synchronous capture.

dependency_graph.common_rule: CS# low begins a transaction; the 48-bit Command-Address on DQ[7:0] precedes the initial latency, which precedes the DDR data phase. Read capture depends on the memory-driven RWDS strobe; variable latency depends on the RWDS level during the CA phase.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Data transfer requires: (1) CS# asserted, (2) a valid 48-bit CA, (3) the configured initial latency elapsed (fixed, or variable per RWDS-during-CA). Read data is captured against RWDS; write data is masked by RWDS.

logical_signaling_levels.name: CA phase
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Host drives the 48-bit Command-Address on DQ[7:0] over three clocks.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Read data
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Memory drives DDR data on DQ[7:0] with RWDS as the edge-aligned read strobe.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Write data
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Host drives DDR data on DQ[7:0] with RWDS as the byte mask.

ordering_rules.ca_order: 48-bit Command-Address sent MSB byte first over three clocks (six DDR bytes).
ordering_rules.data_order: DDR data one byte per CK edge on DQ[7:0]; wrapped / linear / hybrid bursts.
ordering_rules.tx_rx_simultaneity: Half-duplex on the shared DQ bus; only one direction at a time.
